items.mainDefect: Google Calendar createEvent picks the destination calendar by matching credentialId, so destination calendars that have no credentialId never match and the event goes to 'primary' instead of the selected calendar.

secondary.defect: The interface change is inconsistent: the new credentialId argument is ignored by the other calendar implementations (Office365, Lark, CalDAV).

items.mainDefect: `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...)` does nothing when destinationCalendar is null, so a collective event silently drops all team members' destination calendars.

secondary.defect: teamDestinationCalendars is filled inside async map callbacks, which is fragile.
